description: Unit tests for the KernelTimeout class in the Abseil synchronization internal library, testing timeout behaviors, conversions, and edge cases.

classes.name: KernelTimeout
classes.description: Class representing a timeout, supporting absolute and relative timeouts, with special values for infinite and past timeouts.

methods.name: KernelTimeout
methods.description: Constructs a KernelTimeout with a specific absolute or relative time or special value.

methods.name: has_timeout
methods.description: Checks if the timeout is finite or infinite.

methods.name: is_absolute_timeout
methods.description: Checks if the timeout is absolute.

methods.name: is_relative_timeout
methods.description: Checks if the timeout is relative.

methods.name: MakeAbsTimespec
methods.description: Returns the absolute timespec for the timeout.

methods.name: MakeRelativeTimespec
methods.description: Returns the relative timespec for the timeout.

methods.name: MakeAbsNanos
methods.description: Returns the absolute timeout in nanoseconds.

methods.name: InMillisecondsFromNow
methods.description: Returns the timeout in milliseconds from now.

methods.name: ToChronoTimePoint
methods.description: Converts the timeout to a std::chrono::time_point.

methods.name: ToChronoDuration
methods.description: Converts the timeout to a std::chrono::duration.
